scripts.e2e: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,hosting 'node scripts/e2e.mjs'
scripts.dev: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions,hosting
scripts.test:firestore: npm --prefix functions run build:test && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore 'node --test functions/lib-test/test/store-firestore.test.js'
scripts.e2e:agent: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,hosting 'node scripts/e2e-agent.mjs'
